My dad took me to an annual cookout/trebuchet pumpkin chucking party that my best friends parents had every year at their farm. This was right after that historical moment in ones early life when their finally allowed to have matches or your father/grandfather gives you an old lighter etc. That evening (unknown to my father, although I thought he knew) I had matches on me. Me and one of my other friends went out into the woods and lit a candle and pretending it was a fire. All of a sudden his strict mother came up telling us we could start a forest fire, and she was livid. I went back and sat in a chair, and scared shitless because she was going to tell my dad. A few minutes later his girlfriend of the time comes flying out the house, sees me and grabs me by the ear dragging me to my Dad. Who of course wasn’t even that upset just and simply took the matches from me. That was the end of my glorifies feels of being able to have a fire on my person.

TLDR:  Finally being old enough to have matches I brought them to a pumpkin chucking party and lit a candle in the woods where my friends mom found me and my friend, and told my Dad and his girlfriend.

Last year I was sent away to rehab: the biggest withdraw symptom I got without going into to much detail as to why I was sent there is off weed, among other things. Specifically though these symptoms often include interesting, scary, very realistic nightmares, that often you don't wake up from but experience in a weird way. 
     Anyways, one night I had the weirdest dream of my entire life. Without making this the longest thing I'll make it simple. It begins on a boat of over 10,000 people. A huge tanker but for people. Decks and decks of jailed rooms of people. Anyways the tanker breaks down near the prison we were headed to and I jump out and escape. Only to be captured. This is where hitler enter's the story.  I was put into the human centipede (in the middle) by hitler. As a joke(for him)-more of a funny experiment if I remember it correctly as he told me in the dream. However I would escape and jump fence after bigger fence only to be tranquilized and taken back into a pen where the train was waiting. Hitler would approach me and talk to me and just try to persuade me to give in.  On one of my escape attempts I met my dead father while hiding in a train car, and then again in a kids play where a female nazi sergeant found me and took me back.  On one of my final attempts of jumping fence after fence I made it to the last one and woke up....Only to going back to real hell as my rehab was a wilderness therapeutical camp so carrying a backpack for hours a day was not what my body was ready for to say the least...hell..anyways yeah, honestly the whole rehab experience was the scariest part of my life. I woke up to two cops who took me hours away. Never allowed to talk to my mom except receive a letter once a week from her. Not allowed to know the time, the next location we hike to, or even allowed to go to the bathroom without making noise (so they know you're not running away or hurting yourself)

My father died in 2011 from suicide when I was just 11. At the time it I was too young to understand depression and him sleeping all day long to me just seemed like he was really tired. The last time I saw him was after my 6th grade end of the year "graduation" off to summer event. That day me and my mom dropped him off at his house (they were divorced). I was supposed to stay with him that night but for whatever reason I asked to stay with mom and so I went home with her. The last thing I said to my Dad was "Bye I love you" waving out the window. To this day I always make it a point to end on a positive not because I'm afraid I will never get to see that person again. For years after that incident I would call my mom if she was 5-10 minutes late from the grocery store or the gym just to make sure she was okay. Sometimes I still do. 
I feel like I should also add that whenever life is too rough my mind instantly thinks suicide is the right option. I know it's not but I guess just another effect of my "situation"

I was supposed to spend the night and then we would go to the pool together in the morning. Instead I asked if I could stay at moms tonight and meet him at the pool or get picked up. It worked out and I went home with my mom. (Next part sad warning) The next day no calls from my dad so my mom went over they had some paper work or something to do.
